scientific_role: Compose the already-selected M1-v2 provider surrogates in the native AICon/YAFS G0 graph, extract top-level request traces, and estimate graph-level sigma_G before consulting graph-level white-box outcomes.

allowed_before_prediction: hash-frozen public rho-conditioned I1 provider cards
selected non-smoke M1-v2 provider lift parameters
public deterministic fixed-stage and network terms already frozen for M0
forbidden_before_prediction: private Phase-2 provider traces or ledgers
retuning provider lift parameters from graph-level outcomes
external_evaluation_after_prediction: frozen Phase-1 graph-level white-box request ledgers

graph_contract.fixed_stages_and_network: Use the already-public deterministic G0 adapter values; do not read hidden provider fields from Phase 1.
graph_contract.provider_rng_streams: independent deterministic streams derived from the graph-trajectory seed and provider ordinal

graph_simulation.extracted_trace: one reduced top-level request ledger per trajectory plus one concatenated ledger

graph_query.A_G_construction: For each rho_G, forward-compose the public A_i(rho_G) boundaries with the public deterministic fixed-stage/network terms exactly as in M0.
graph_query.horizon_support: use the common public I1 horizon support
graph_query.accounting_origin: use the common public I1 workload accounting origin

external_evaluation.comparison: At each rho_G, compare I1-M1 and I1-M0 with white-box sigma evaluated at the same induced A_G(rho_G).
external_evaluation.plot: five same-rho panels containing WB, I1-M0, and I1-M1 curves

freeze_rule: This remains an implementation/evaluation candidate. The graph prediction is materialized from public I1 and frozen M1-v2 lifts before white-box ledgers are opened. White-box evaluation may assess but never retune the provider lifts or graph simulator in this run.
